checks: Blank, negative, nonfinite and malformed values are rejected
Zero and report inequalities are retained; follicle counts require whole numbers
Actual valid collection date is required, with no future date or substituted age
Explicit compatible units/symbols are required and values are never converted
Only entered numeric limits are compared; absent/one-sided/bounded results stay explicit
Dated result/source/assay survive reload while legacy snapshot stays byte-for-byte unchanged
New results append; explicit edit updates one record while preserving others and creation time
Malformed or unsupported saved data cannot be overwritten by a new save
Storage read/write failures propagate without modifying prior records
scope: Input, storage and arithmetic behavior only; no clinical interpretation or validation
